# Sirach Chapter 24 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 24 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**Council Notes:**
This is THE theological climax of Sirach, and one of the most consequential passages in the deuterocanonical literature. Wisdom (Hokmah / Sophia) speaks in the divine assembly, describes her cosmic origin and universal dominion, her search for a dwelling place, and her establishment in Israel. The climax comes at v. 23: "All these things are the book of the covenant of the Most High God, the law which Moses commanded us." In one move, Ben Sira identifies the pre-existent cosmic Wisdom with the Torah given at Sinai — a move that has no parallel in earlier literature.

Theological significance:
- V. 3 "from the mouth of the Most High" — later reused in John 1 for the Logos/Word
- V. 9 "From eternity / before the beginning" — pre-existence of Wisdom (cf. Prov 8:22-31)
- V. 23 "All these things are the book of the covenant" — Wisdom = Torah identification
- V. 21 "eat... and hunger still; drink... and thirst still" — quoted/alluded to in John 6

All agents agree: this chapter demands gravity. No colloquializing the theological affirmations.

Note on v. 18/19 numbering: Vaticanus numbering skips v. 18 in some critical editions; v. 19 follows v. 17 directly. V. 24 and v. 34 are bracketed as possible additions in some MSS.

---

**24:1** Wisdom praises her own soul, and in the midst of her people she glories.

**24:2** In the assembly of the Most High she opens her mouth, and before his heavenly host she glories:

**24:3** "I came forth from the mouth of the Most High, and like a mist I covered the earth.

**24:4** I dwelt in the heights, and my throne was in a pillar of cloud.

**24:5** The vault of heaven I encircled alone, and in the depths of the abyss I walked about.

**24:6** In the waves of the sea and over all the earth, and among every people and nation, I held dominion.

**24:7** Among all of these I sought a resting place, in whose inheritance I would make my dwelling.

**24:8** Then the Creator of all gave me his command, and he who created me gave rest to my tent; and he said: 'Let your dwelling place be in Jacob, and in Israel let your inheritance be.'

**24:9** From eternity, before the beginning, he created me; and to eternity I shall not cease.

**24:10** In the holy tent I ministered before him, and so I was established in Zion.

**24:11** In the city he loved he likewise gave me rest, and in Jerusalem was my domain.

**24:12** I took root among a people he had honored — in the LORD's own portion, his inheritance.

**24:13** Like a cedar in Lebanon I was exalted, and like a cypress on the mountains of Hermon.

**24:14** Like a palm tree I was exalted in En-gedi, and like rose-bushes in Jericho; like a beautiful olive tree in the plain, and like a plane tree I spread myself out.

**24:15** Like cinnamon and fragrant aspalathos I gave forth fragrance; like choice myrrh I breathed out sweet aroma; like galbanum and onycha and stacte, and like the cloud of frankincense in the holy tent.

**24:16** Like a terebinth I spread out my branches, and my branches are branches of glory and of grace.

**24:17** Like a vine I put forth graceful shoots, and my blossoms bear fruit of glory and of abundance.

**24:19** Come to me, all you who desire me, and eat your fill of my produce.

**24:20** For the remembrance of me is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance sweeter than the honeycomb.

**24:21** Those who eat me will hunger still for more, and those who drink me will thirst still for more.

**24:22** Whoever obeys me will not be put to shame, and those who work in me will not sin."

**24:23** All these things are the book of the covenant of the Most High God, the law which Moses commanded us as an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob.

**24:24** [He fills it with wisdom like the Pishon, and like the Tigris in the days of the first fruits.]

**24:25** He fills it with understanding like the Euphrates, and like the Jordan in the days of harvest.

**24:26** He makes instruction shine forth like light — like the Gehon in the days of the vintage.

**24:27** The first man has not finished knowing her, and likewise the last has not traced out her ways.

**24:28** For from the sea her thought was filled, and her counsel from the great deep.

**24:29** I myself am like a canal from a river, and like a water channel I went out into a garden.

**24:30** I said, "I will water my garden and drench my garden bed"; and behold, my canal became a river, and my river became a sea.

**24:31** I will make instruction shine again like the morning light, and cause it to gleam afar.

**24:32** I will again pour out teaching like prophecy, and leave it for generations to come.

**24:33** See that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all who seek wisdom.

**24:34** [See that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all those who seek her.]
